response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years across web, backend, and some embedded work, and demonstrates strong software-craftsmanship habits (TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, public speaking). However, the role's core requirement — deep, current C++/STL expertise for high-performance on-premises and industrial platforms — is essentially absent: C++ appears only in a ~7-month stint at National Instruments (2014–2015) and a university thesis, and it is not even listed among current skills. There is no evidence of IEC 62443 / Secure Development Lifecycle practice, MQTT or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850), or industrial automation/IoT domain exposure. Recent work is TypeScript/Node/AWS full-stack and AI tooling, which is a poor match for the hands-on C++ architecture focus of this position.
strengths: Deep distributed/event-driven, low-latency systems experience (Sociomantic, millions of req/s)
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, mentoring and teaching
Broad polyglot background including some C/C++ and embedded/hardware exposure
concerns: Minimal and dated C++/STL experience; not a current core skill
No IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity background
No industrial automation, MQTT, or OT protocol (Modbus/OPC UA) experience

key_factors.factor: Industrial automation / security standards (IEC 62443, SDL, MQTT)
High-performance concurrent and distributed systems track record
